label: Beginningless existential provenance: replaceable anchors versus the positive actuality input
summary: In the #1801 whole-history law/sustaining comparison (docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md §7), preserved the success of actual prior bearer plus no destructive inducer plus an existential persistence law at each later time. Reused #736's whole-vector contrast and #753's verified constant_of_stationary/shift-invariance work rather than registering a duplicate selection theorem. On bi-infinite Int time an explicitly STRONGER reversible existence rule R makes any actual dated anchor E_x(s) sufficient for all of the same rigid bearer's existence stages; every particular anchor can be replaced by another. Yet R admits two independently populated histories (ever-present background b, x always present versus never present), so its common indispensable positive existential input is the disjunctive fact A_x = there is some time at which x exists, not a privileged initial moment. The equivalence A_x iff x always exists is conditional on R, and R is not a consequence of the one-way inertialist persistence P; the history assignments are structural surrogates, not complete metaphysical alternatives. An optional non-circular ultimate-completeness norm can require an account to explain existential inputs on which it essentially depends; its universal application and a proposed stronger no-constituent-sine-qua-non criterion remain disputed. The latter must not exclude ordinary two-step accounts (friction explains ignition, ignition explains flame) that explain internal intermediate inputs too. The Humean law-actuality cycle is strictly conditional on SAME fact, SAME metaphysical grounding relation and asymmetry; scientific law explanation, earlier-facts-only lawhood and independent governing laws escape the strict argument. Positive surviving rivals: primitive governing law plus basic ontology, intrinsic nature with independent existential scope, non-well-founded/holistic memberwise sufficiency, nonnecessitating reason and brute actuality. A divine source would meet the same source-actuality and no-unexplained-input scrutiny and does not follow from the scope gap. Rejected inference from temporal priority to ontological ground, from no first time to no explanation, from law multiplicity to no explanation, from globally incomplete conditional law to concurrent strict GivesAt, and from a source label to productive coverage. Rota/Pruss are identified as leads only; no new source attribution was made. The outcome adds a targeted philosophical scope audit and exact conditional premise provenance, not a Lean proof, new source claim, independent rejection item for inertia, or root closure. The 2026-11-25 persistence-identity follow-up in the same note §10 tests the exact successor question from PR-1899. The London cast's physical handling and the separate manufacture of a scan-derived bronze distinguish a surviving token from a causal descendant. Equal parts, matching qualities, causal influence in general and merely reusing the same rigid Lean variable fail to identify a continuant. The independently tracked case supports historical contribution to reidentification. It leaves open a joint account on which productive conservation is indispensable for that very individual. See §10 for primary locators, the sole-producer reply, exact Lean types and the maximum/root application.
blocker: The #1801 existential ultimate-completeness criterion needs independent warrant against a concrete holistic/non-well-founded account of the same A_x and a genuinely ontic governing-law-plus-material-ontology package, with nonnecessitating grounds allowed. Materialize and read any Rota/Pruss witnesses before attribution. A qualified law-versus-actuality comparison, even if ultimately favoring a global productive ground, does not establish the separate actual-concrete-source or whole-history-to-per-moment strict GivesAt bridge; 40a97664 and 2068f91c stay OPEN. At the local identity test, both the law account and continuous conservation track the same bearer. Test independently identified withdrawal of all strict giving to this earlier bearer, including any other giver or self-giving. Independently classify causes of loss and track whether the bearer survives. Observing a giver in action does not establish indispensability. Material custody alone cannot perform that test.

current_assessment.scope: The #1801 identity discriminator for an already actual material bearer with received esse and a still-present originating source. The selected relation is productive giving of the very bearer's esse.
current_assessment.assessment: Strong defeasible support for using the earlier individual's own material history to distinguish continuation from a copy in ordinary artifact cases. Copying can transmit causally specific information, while transport and changes in posture preserve a token. Equality excludes identifying two distinct later tokens with the earlier one. These facts support neither the claim that earlier existence efficiently produces later esse nor the claim that such production requires a concurrent source. The governing-law and joint-conservation accounts both recover the independently warranted identity. Weak C3 and its GOD_4 support route remain conditional.
current_assessment.next_test: Reopen the identity comparison if one account predicts a specific replacement or loss despite independently traced bearer continuity, or if an account of restoration can distinguish recovery of the original from successful copying after a total break. For C3 test an independently identified withdrawal of production of esse, with the source present, the same earlier patient, all other strict giving excluded (including self-giving), an independently warranted assessment of destructive conditions and an observed outcome.
current_assessment.evidence: Section 10 contains the complete local proposal awaiting independent challenge. Offline truth frontier-diff --base 4e44d8ce8 --head 2372eca23 reports no change and zero verified support alternatives added. This is the identity slice's delta against its starting head.
